findings.passage: Co-authored legislation to promote election integrity by expanding early voting and making it harder to commit voter fraud (SB 1, 87-2), increase funding for border security efforts (HB 9, 87-2), and ensure fair play in girl’s sports (HB 25, 87-3)
findings.note: Campaign site bio lists his co-authorship of the 2021 special-session election bill SB 1 and describes it in his own words. Page is undated; date is the date the page was read.

findings.passage: Defended against point of order and passed SB 12 to restore authority of Attorney General to prosecute election offenses.
findings.note: Campaign site bio lists his floor work on SB 12 (attorney general power to prosecute election offenses). Page is undated; date is the date the page was read.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 5337, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as one of 56 coauthors (author: Isaac) of HB 5337, which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote and create criminal offenses. Bill was filed 2025-03-14 and the House Elections committee reported it as substituted on 2025-04-28. Date is the bill's filing date, not the date he signed on.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 892, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor (author: Cain) of HB 892, captioned as requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote. Bill was filed 2024-11-12 and referred to Elections on 2025-03-06. Date is the bill's filing date, not the date he signed on.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HJR 161, constitutional amendment adding non-citizens to the classes barred from voting
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor (author: Noble) of HJR 161, a proposed constitutional amendment to add people who are not U.S. citizens to the classes of persons not allowed to vote. The House laid it on the table subject to call on 2025-05-09 and took up its companion SJR 37 instead. Date is that last action, not the date he signed on.
